stemMarkdown: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 3 : 5. After 6 years, their ages will be in the ratio 36 : 56. What is A's present age (in years)?
solutionMarkdown: Let the present ages be $3x$ and $5x$. Then $\dfrac{3x + 6}{5x + 6} = \dfrac{36}{56}$. Cross-multiplying and solving gives $x = 10$, so A is $3 \times 10 = 30$ years old.
